fields.name: Chakka Panja 5
fields.casts: Deepak Raj Giree, Kedar Prasad Ghimire, Barsha Siwakoti
fields.description: Chhakka Panja 5 is the 5th Nepali Feature Film from Chhakka Panja Franchise, starring Deepak Raj Giree, Kedar Prasad Ghimire, Barsha Siwakoti and directed by Deepa Shree Niraula.

fields.name: 12 Gaun
fields.casts: Sameer Bhatt, Biraj Bhatt, Sonu Chandrapal, Deeya Maskey
fields.description: 12 Gaun is a thrilling tale where romance meets relentless action, revealing deep-seated social issues. Witness courage, betrayal and redemption as heroes rise against adversity.

fields.name: Jwai Saab
fields.casts: Jitu Nepal, Niti Shah, Buddhi Tamang, Himesh Pant
fields.description: Jwai Saab is a Nepali Feature Film starring Jitu Nepal, Niti Shah & Buddhi Tamang directed by Basanta Niraula.

fields.name: Behuli From Meghauli
fields.casts: Swastima Khadka, Nischal Basnet, Basundhara Bhusal, Bijay Baral
fields.description: Behuli From Meghauli is a Nepali movie starring Nischal Basnet, Swastima Khadka and directed by Sajan Kafle & Aakash Baral.
